title: What to Say When You Didn’t Get the Joke
subtitle: Find out how to deal with tricky social situations in English

items.meaningEn: A joke that is understood or meant to be understood only by certain people who are aware of the details.
items.meaningZh: 一个只有某些了解细节的人才能理解或有意理解的笑话。

occurrences.sentence: I feel like if it's in English, it's usually an inside joke, right?
occurrences.sentenceZh: 我觉得如果用英语的话 通常是内部笑话,对吧?

occurrences.sentence: With the inside joke thing, honestly, I think that's just a faux pas on whoever's
occurrences.sentenceZh: 和里面的笑话,说实话, 我认为这只是一个faux pas对谁的

examples: After the incident with the potato peeler, references to potatoes became an inside joke among the witnesses.

items.meaningEn: A pun, or similar humorous use of language such as a double entendre.
items.meaningZh: 或类似幽默地使用语言如双关语。

occurrences.sentence: It'll be like something cultural or a play on words that I didn't quite catch.
occurrences.sentenceZh: 它会像一些文化 或一出戏剧 语言,我没有 完全赶上。

occurrences.sentence: There are so many plays on words.

examples:
1794, Mr. Malone's Edition of Shakſpeare's Works, in The Monthly Review Or Literary Journal Enlarged [2nd Series], Volume 13, R. Griffiths, page 265,
Mr. Steevens alſo, influenced we ſuppoſe by the authority of Dr. Farmer, ſeems by the way in which he regulates the line in his new edition, to think that Shakſpeare here meaned no more than a play on words.

1897, Jas. W. Tupper, English Drama: Das Wortspiel bei Shakspere, von Leopold Wurth, A. Marshall Elliott (managing editor), Modern Language Notes, Volume XII, page 171,
There are two general classes under which all the examples are grouped: plays on words which are due to a double meaning, and the plays merely on sound (die Laut- oder Klaugspiele). The term for the latter group Dr. Wurth gives as puns, punnings.
